svg.title: Step 7 mockup 14: Follow along: standings, a live session, champions, the rules (attendees, spectators)
svg.text: 14 · Follow along: standings, a live session, champions, the rules (attendees, spectators)
Use case: anyone at the event follows the tournament from the hub without playing: what is on, who leads, who won. A hero and a ranked list, never a grid of cards.

svg.text: Standings, a live session and the champions are public inside the
event: no sign-in to read (U15). Standings and champions are a
hero and a ranked list; cards are for like items with no order.
The live session is a day-schedule list that updates by push; the
champions page shows the final ranking, then awards and session
The rules page is written by the organiser; points and the cut
come from the settings. After the event the player sees their own
summary; results are anonymised after 12 months.
